programme_facts.value: Nondegree applicants do not have to send transcripts or supportive documents to be admitted.
Submit your application at least one week prior to the first day of classes.
Financial aid is not available to nondegree students.
Your application will remain active for up to two terms or as long as you are enrolled in classes.
VA education benefits are often not applicable to nondegree-seeking students.
The application will ask for your contact information.
The application will ask for the major and campus you would like to attend.
The application will ask if you will self-report your high school grades.
Self-reporting grades is recommended as it will speed up admission decision time.
If you choose not to self-report your grades, you can have your school submit your official transcripts to ASU.
Grades are an important factor in being admitted, and some programs may require even higher grades than the university does.
Good grades are important for admission to Barrett, The Honors College, though there is no minimum GPA required.
It is advisable to apply to more than one college to have options if not admitted to the preferred college.
The number of colleges to apply to may be limited by application fees.
Most students take the ACT or SAT in the spring of their junior year, summer after their junior year, or fall of their senior year.
Students should consider taking the PSAT in October of their junior year to be considered for National Merit and National Recognition Scholarship programs.
